# MM-P1-L2-RR01-S1 Lubrication and fluids - Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #1

Revision: Rev A  
Plant: P1, line P1-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L2-RR01

## Scope
This document defines lubrication and fluid handling for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L2-RR01). It covers lubricant selection, lubrication points, fluid storage and transfer precautions, and inspection acceptance criteria relevant to normal production and maintenance activities. This procedure applies to operations where the maximum ring outer diameter for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L2-RR01) is 995 mm. Related references: ECN-2026-009, SB-1020, SOP-P1-L2-01.

## Background and rationale
Proper lubrication and fluid control on EQ-P1-L2-RR01 reduce wear, prevent seizure, and maintain dimensional stability of rolled rings. The specified lubricant minimizes metal-to-metal contact at sliding interfaces and is compatible with the machine's seals and bearings. Using the correct lubricant part number ensures supply chain traceability and material safety data sheet (MSDS) compliance: CFW-LUB-961.

This mill is used for rings up to the stated maximum outer diameter; larger rings require alternative equipment or process approval per ECN-2026-009. The goals of this document are to standardize lubrication practice, document inspection points, and define acceptance criteria for service records and fluid condition.

## Tools and materials
- Manufacturer-approved dispensing system with appropriate filtering and contamination control
- Clean containers labeled per SB-1020
- Funnel with anti-contamination screen
- Lint-free wipes and particle-free applicators
- Personal protective equipment as specified in SOP-P1-L2-01 and the lubricant MSDS: CFW-LUB-961
- Sample bottles for fluid condition sampling, labeled and sealed
- Inspection mirror and borescope for visual access to bearings and housings
- Permanent logbook or electronic maintenance record system conforming to SB-1020

Do not substitute CFW-LUB-961 without written authorization captured in ECN-2026-009.

## Procedure
Overview: The procedure is divided into preparatory controls, lubricant application, condition monitoring, and records. Follow SOP-P1-L2-01 for lockout and safety steps before any disassembly.

Preparatory controls
- Verify work area is clean and free of swarf and coolant carryover. Use lint-free wipes to remove visible debris from lubrication points.
- Ensure lubricant stock is verified against part number CFW-LUB-961 and MSDS is available at the point of use.
- Confirm the current production profile is within the machine rating; recall that the maximum ring outer diameter for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L2-RR01) is 995 mm and do not attempt rings larger than this rating.

Lubricant application
- Use the approved dispensing system to deliver CFW-LUB-961 to bearings, slides, and gear interfaces. Avoid introducing particulate contamination by using the filtering capability of the dispenser.
- Apply lubricant to exposed sliding surfaces with a clean applicator. For internal bearings or gearboxes, use the fill or lubrication port designed by the equipment manufacturer; wipe the port clean before opening.
- For greasing of external fittings, apply lubricant until a light purge at the bearing seal is observed or until the applied film is continuous across the sliding surface. Wipe excess lubricant to prevent entrapment of debris.

Condition monitoring and sampling
- Visually inspect lubricant-exposed surfaces for film continuity, leakage paths, and signs of overheating or discoloration indicative of contamination.
- Collect fluid samples in labeled sample bottles after agitation of the reservoir per good-sampling practice. Seal and tag samples for laboratory analysis if there is visual indication of contamination or following a major event. Coordinate laboratory submission with SB-1020.
- Record observed anomalies in the maintenance log and escalate per SOP-P1-L2-01 if contamination, abnormal leakage, or evidence of lubricant incompatibility is found.

Examples and special cases
- Example: If gear mesh shows light scoring but lubricant appears clean, perform a containment cleaning and resume service while increasing inspection frequency. If scoring progresses, prepare an engineering change request per ECN-2026-009.
- Example: If a batch of CFW-LUB-961 is suspected contaminated, quarantine the lot, tag containers, and reference SB-1020 for disposal and replacement actions.

Rationale for steps
- Cleaning prior to application prevents entrapment of abrasive particles that accelerate wear.
- Using the correct part number CFW-LUB-961 prevents seal degradation from incompatible chemistries.
- Sampling and record retention enable trend analysis and root cause identification for rolling quality issues.

## Records to keep
- Maintenance log entries capturing date, technician name, equipment id EQ-P1-L2-RR01, lubricant part used CFW-LUB-961, observed condition, and action taken. Use the format specified in SB-1020.
- Fluid sample labels and laboratory reports when samples are submitted. Reference ECN-2026-009 if sample results prompt an engineering action.
- Receipt and quarantine records for lubricant lots when nonconformance is suspected, retained per SB-1020.

## Acceptance criteria
The lubrication and fluids condition for EQ-P1-L2-RR01 are acceptable when:
- Lubricant in service matches part number CFW-LUB-961 and is within supplier specifications as documented in receiving records.
- Visual inspection shows a continuous protective film at lubrication points with no evidence of abrasive contamination or rapid film breakdown.
- No leakage paths exist that contaminate the rolling surface or interfere with ring handling, and no residue is present that could transfer to parts within the machine envelope.
- Records are complete and include entries per SB-1020 and SOP-P1-L2-01, with any nonconforming findings escalated through ECN-2026-009.

If any acceptance criterion is not met, stop the affected operation and follow escalation and corrective action per SOP-P1-L2-01 and ECN-2026-009.

End of document.
